descriptions.en: Unleash your inner arcade hero. Inspired by the legendary duo Jillian and Lillian, these outfits bring their unstoppable energy and fearless fashion straight to Drifter and Operator. It’s nostalgia, reloaded!
descriptions.zh: 释放你内心的街机英雄。这些服装灵感来自传奇二人组吉利安和莉莉安，将她们不可阻挡的能量和大胆的时尚直接带给了漂泊者和指挥官。这就是重新燃起的怀旧感！

descriptions.en: The information superhighway can be a scary place, especially with a Technocyte Coda watching your every move. Get peace of mind with this set of Antivirus Mods.
descriptions.zh: 信息高速公路可能是一个危机四伏的地方，尤其是当科技细胞终幕者监视着你的一举一动时。使用这套杀毒 Mod，让你高枕无忧。

names.zh: 终幕者杀毒 Mod 组合包

descriptions.en: Fight back against Technocyte Coda threats with this complete collection of Antivirus and Potency mods.
descriptions.zh: 利用这套完整的杀毒和效价 Mod 来反击科技细胞终幕者的威胁。

descriptions.en: Embody Scaldra and their chilling, charismatic leaders with this collection of cosmetic and decorative items.
descriptions.zh: 通过这一系列自定义装饰物来体现炽蛇军及其令人不寒而栗、魅力十足的领导者。

descriptions.en:
Get back in the action with this collection of Gemini Skins from Techrot Encore.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
通过《科腐者安可》的这组双子外观重新投入行动。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: Taking on a Technocyte Coda is a breeze with the assortment of Potency Mods.
descriptions.zh: 借助各种效价 Mod，对抗科技细胞终幕者是轻而易举的事。

names.zh: 终幕者效价 Mod 组合包

descriptions.en: Take the fight to Scaldra with their own fearsome weapons. Quality personally assured by Viktor Vodyanoi.
descriptions.zh: 用炽蛇军自己的可怕武器反击他们。维克多·维德诺伊亲自保证品质。

descriptions.en: Transformed once again, this time into an adorable collection of soft toys, the Hex are waiting to come home with you!
descriptions.zh: 再次变身，这次是变成了一系列可爱的玩偶，六人组正等着和你一起回家！

descriptions.en: Dare to define the cutting edge. Transform Drifter and Operator into pioneers of goth, grunge, and athletic chic, proving that science isn't the only frontier for Höllvania.
descriptions.zh: 敢于定义前沿。让漂泊者和指挥官变身为哥特风、颓废风和运动风时尚的先驱，证明科学并不是霍瓦尼亚的唯一前沿。

This bundle may only be purchased once per account.

        Dante Warframe
        Dante Cantist Helmet
        Oranist Armor
        Rencowl Syandana
        Ruvox Melee Weapon
        Noctua's Paragrimm
<MINI_ARROW> Extras
        Observant Vitreum
        Dante's Delight Glyph
        Dante's Noctua Sigil
        125 Platinum

This pack may only be purchased once per account.

        Dante 的喜悦浮印

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Embolden the Hex's virtuous cause by adding this suite of Protoframe Gemini Skins and corresponding Gemini Emotes to your Arsenal.

This Collection includes:

- Flare Gemini Skin + Flare Gemini Emote
- Velimir Gemini Skin + Velimir Gemini Emote
- Minerva Gemini Skin + Minerva Gemini Emote
- Kaya Gemini Skin + Kaya Gemini Emote
- 475 Platinum

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过将这套原型战甲双子外观及和相应的双子表情动作添加至你的军械库，以壮大六人组的正义事业。

该组合包内含：

- 弗莱尔双子外观 + 弗莱尔双子表情动作
- 维利米尔双子外观 + 维利米尔双子表情动作
- 米尼娃双子外观 + 米尼娃双子表情动作
- 卡娅双子外观 + 卡娅双子表情动作
- 475 白金

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

descriptions.en:
Bring the house down by adding Temple's ruinous riffs, plus their signature Weapons and Customizations, to your Arsenal.

This bundle may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
将 Temple 的毁灭之音，以及他的标志性武器和自定义装饰，加入你的军械库中。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

descriptions.en: Grow strong with Nokko, brave defender of the Deepmines.
descriptions.zh: 与深矿的勇敢捍卫者 Nokko 一起成长。

descriptions.en: Stalk your prey through the floating islands of Duviri with the new Oraxia Bundle! Featuring the deadly hunter Oraxia, as well as her signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh: 通过全新的 Oraxia 组合包，在双衍王境的漂浮岛屿上追踪你的猎物！内含致命猎手 Oraxia，以及她的标志性武器和自定义装饰。

descriptions.en:
Summon the primordial legacy of the beast with the Rhino Heirloom Steel Collection. Featuring Customizations girded with living iron capable of withstanding any storm.

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过 Rhino 传家宝钢之组合包召唤出野兽的原始传承。以能够抵御任何风暴的活铁自定义装饰为特色。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

names.zh: Rhino 传家宝钢之组合包

descriptions.en:
Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!

Keep in mind that with access to Baro's TennoCon 2025 Relay, you'll also be able to trade Ducats for every item Baro has ever sold.

The TennoCon 2025 Digital Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅当下限时发售！

请记住，拥有访问 Baro 的 TennoCon 2025 中继站的权限，你可以使用杜卡德金币交易 Baro 出售过的所有物品。

TennoCon 2025 虚拟礼包为限时发售，每个账号仅限购买一次。

descriptions.en: Face harrowing memories of war and seek redemption - or retribution - in answer to the question: Can the Orokin ever be forgiven?
descriptions.zh: 面对战争的痛苦回忆，寻求救赎——或者复仇——只需以回答以下问题：奥罗金能否得到宽恕？

descriptions.en:
Deepen the bonds of camaraderie between the three unlikely companions of the Devil's Triad with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
通过这组原型战甲双子外观，加深恶魔三重奏中三位看似不可能的伙伴之间的友谊。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: Call down brimstone-laced devastation and take command of demonic servitors with Uriel, the Heretic of Xata.
descriptions.zh: 与 Xata 的异端者 Uriel 一起，召唤硫磺带来的毁灭性灾难，并指挥恶魔的仆从。

descriptions.en: Valkyr rises in majesty, casting off her legacy of torment in the Valkyr Heirloom Collection! Heirloom Customizations signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 的崛起威风凛凛，在 Valkyr 传家宝组合包中摆脱了她苦难的过往。传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和 Tenno 的付出。

descriptions.en: Embark upon an epic journey with this collection of skins and items for Wukong Qitian.
descriptions.zh: 与这套 Wukong 齐天大圣外观及物品组合包一同踏上史诗之旅。

descriptions.en: Take on the dangers of the Origin System with the thundering power of the Fulmin rifle and shot-enhancing Split Chamber Mod. Do it all in style with the dazzling Opula Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 手持威力震天的雷霆步枪，搭配增强射击效果的分裂膛室 Mod，直面始源星系的险境。身披耀眼的缤纷幻纹，以非凡姿态纵横战场。
身穿熠熠生辉的缤纷护甲套装，凭借冷冻光束步枪的冰冷火力和令人不寒而栗的光子过载 Mod，直面始源星系的险境。
身穿熠熠生辉的缤纷护甲套装，凭借冷冻光束步枪的冰冷火力和令人不寒而栗的光子过载 Mod，直面始源星系的险境。

names.zh: 缤纷冷冻光束步枪套装

descriptions.en: Make art your weapon, with the shadowgrapher Follie
descriptions.zh: 通过绘影者 Follie 将艺术与你的武器完美融合

descriptions.en: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis: keep this inseparable odd couple together forever.
descriptions.zh: Gauss 摩托和 Grendel 暴坦：让这对形影不离的奇特组合永远在一起。
化身为冬日风暴之灵。Narin 锋利的细剑在呼啸的暴风雪之中舞动，剑气冲霄，即带来庇护，也带来毁灭。

descriptions.en: Confront the legacy of a doomed future. Is there room for harmony in the present?
descriptions.zh: 直面未来注定毁灭的宿命。当下是否还存在和平共处的空间？

descriptions.en:
Fight an eternal battle for the future with Vena, the blood-loving fanatic, and Ryoku, the cool and calculating killer. Two bitter rivals brought together in this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins. 

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
与嗜血狂热者维纳和冷静狡黠的杀手忍力一同，为未来展开一场永恒之战。这两位宿敌将在这组原型战甲双子外观中并肩作战。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: What might have been becomes reality with Sirius & Orion. Assume the full might of dueling dark futures and follow the stars to constellations of combined power.
descriptions.zh: 在 Sirius 与 Orion 的交汇处，曾经的可能化为现实。感受两股黑暗未来交锋的磅礴之力，追随星辰，探寻众星的融合之力。

names.zh: 众星 Sirius & Orion 组合包

descriptions.en: Saunter into the fray and send outlaws to their graves with the Mesa Heirloom Collection. Let her Regulators echo a ballad beneath the high-noon sun.
descriptions.zh: 使用 Mesa 传家宝组合包，从容踏入战场，将亡命之徒送入黄泉。让她的监察者双枪在正午烈日下奏响一曲传奇。

descriptions.en: Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!
descriptions.zh: 即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅限时发售！

descriptions.en: Refine the legacy of a genius tactician with this collection of bold Heirloom items.
descriptions.zh: 通过这一系列大胆的传家宝物品，传承天才战术家的传奇。

descriptions.en: Purchase Platinum, an in-game currency you can spend on Warframes, Weapons, Customizations and more from the in-game Market to reinforce your Arsenal. Weapons and Warframes can also be earned and crafted in-game for free. Platinum can also be used to instantly finish crafting items in the Foundry, or traded with other players in-game for rare items like Mods and Prime Warframe components.
descriptions.zh: 白金是游戏内的货币，可在游戏中的商店中用于购买战甲、武器、自定义装饰，以及更多物品，来强化你的军械库。武器和战甲也可以通过游玩任务免费获取并打造。白金还可用于在铸造厂中立即完成物品的打造，或在游戏里与其他玩家交易，换取例如 Mod 和 Prime 战甲组件等稀有物品。

Weapons and Warframes can also be earned and crafted in-game for free. descriptions.en: Declare your devotion to the Zariman with this Glyph and Sigil for your profile.
descriptions.zh: 将这些浮印和纹章加入你的个人档案中，向扎里曼表达你的忠诚。

descriptions.en:
INSTANTLY REINFORCE YOUR ARSENAL!

Venture into the dark Void of the Zariman with a fully reinforced Arsenal! Add new Weapons, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal for a limited time, including the evolving Tenno badge of honor, the Vasero Sekhara, and the striking Hespar Scythe.

Pack Includes:
- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Heavy Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster

One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
即刻强化你的军械库！

携带完全强化过的军械库进入「扎里曼号」的幽暗虚空！在限定的时间内，将全新的武器、自定义装饰、加成物品，以及更多精彩物品添加到你的军械库，其中包括可进化的星种饰冠和引人注目的暮斩镰刀。

组合包内含：
- 星种饰冠
- 暮斩重型镰刀
- 狂风压境架式 Mod
- 扎里曼浮印*
- 扎里曼纹章*
- 7 天资源数量加成
- 7 天资源掉落几率加成

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 “*” 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

names.en: Angels of the Zariman Emergence Pack
names.zh: 《扎里曼的天使》初露锋芒组合包

descriptions.en:
UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL!

Venture into the dark Void of the Zariman with a fully reinforced Arsenal! Unleash electric fury as the newest Warframe, Gyre; unlock a bounty of new Customizations with Voidshell Warframe Skins; and master brand-new Weapons as you bring light to the dark and deadly Zariman.

Pack Includes:
- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Heavy Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster
- 500 Platinum
- Gyre Warframe
- Gyre Automaton Helmet
- Gyratory Sphere Decoration
- Triodic Syandana
- Alternox Rifle
- Saryn Voidshell Skin
- Volt Voidshell Skin
- Rhino Voidshell Skin
- 18 Material Structures

One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
即刻强化你的军械库！

携带完全强化过的军械库进入「扎里曼号」的幽暗虚空！化身为最新的战甲 Gyre 来释放狂电之怒；通过虚空之壳战甲外观解锁大量全新的自定义装饰；并驾驭全新的武器来为幽暗致命的「扎里曼号」带来希望之光。

组合包内含：
- 星种饰冠
- 暮斩重型镰刀
- 狂风压境架式 Mod
- 扎里曼浮印*
- 扎里曼纹章*
- 7 天资源数量加成
- 7 天资源掉落几率加成
- 500 白金
- Gyre 战甲
- Gyre 姬械头盔
- 回旋球装饰 
- 三重披饰
- 电幻步枪
- Saryn 虚空之壳外观
- Volt 虚空之壳外观
- Rhino 虚空之壳外观
- 18 材料结构

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 “*” 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

names.en: Angels of the Zariman Chrysalith Pack
names.zh: 《扎里曼的天使》羽化之穹组合包

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the followers of the Stalker.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含追猎者的追随者的摇头娃娃包。

descriptions.en: Show off your style, with this action packed collection of Warframe glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 用这款充满动感的战甲浮印组合包展现你的风格。

descriptions.en: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的独家服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

descriptions.en: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

descriptions.en: Sneak behind enemy lines with this collection of scavenged Grineer Lancer armor. Fitted for The Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 使用这套 Grineer 枪兵护甲组合包深入敌后。为漂泊者量身定制。

names.zh: 漂泊者 Grineer 组合包

descriptions.en: Keep it real on the streets with this collection of thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

descriptions.en: Have the Operator or Drifter embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
descriptions.zh: 让指挥官或漂泊者穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

descriptions.en: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Drifter or Operator's too.
descriptions.zh: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，漂泊者或指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

descriptions.en: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 漂泊者独孤游侠组合包

descriptions.en: A full pressure suit inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 一款以千纸鹤为灵感的密闭服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn's Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 漂泊者凯勒套服组合包

descriptions.en: Lavos the Transmuter emerges from the seething smoke, the forgotten master of a much-misunderstood art. Includes the Lavos Warframe, Cordatus alternate helmet, Transmutation Probe decoration, Vitam Syandana, and Cedo Shotgun. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 炼制术师 Lavos 从翻腾的烟雾中出现，他是被人遗忘的大师，掌握一门被人误解的艺术。包括 Lavos 战甲、明智替换头盔、炼制探头装饰、命脉披饰，以及塞多霰弹枪。还包括 3 天经验值和现金加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of unique arrows, compatible with any bow.
descriptions.zh: 一套独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢组合包。

descriptions.en: A bundle featuring glyphs from Community Artist DarikaArt.
descriptions.zh: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 DarikaArt 设计的浮印。

names.zh: 十一周年玩家社区浮印组合包

descriptions.en: A collection of blueprints containing formulas to create every type of antidote.
descriptions.zh: 一系列用来合成各种解药的配方蓝图。

descriptions.en: Hunt down your prey with this collection of lethal gear. Includes the Ivara Warframe, Rubico sniper rifle, Lacera sword-whip and the explosive Talon throwing darts. Enhance progression with 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 用这组致命的装备追捕你的猎物。道具包中包含 Ivara 战甲、绝路狙击枪、悲痛之刃剑鞭以及装载了爆破物的鹰爪飞镖。外加能协助你加快游戏进度的3天经验与现金加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the followers of Arlo.
descriptions.zh: 一组代表了 Arlo 追随者们的摇头娃娃组合包。

names.zh: 拥护者摇头娃娃组合包

descriptions.zh: 兰卡的闪电迷彩外观。

names.zh: 兰卡 闪电迷彩外观

descriptions.en: Newly discovered composites are what makes this striking armor set possible.
descriptions.zh: 最新发现的复合材料使制作这套惊人的护甲成为可能。

descriptions.en: Arca weapons represent the bleeding-edge of Corpus research and fabrication. This bundle includes the Arca Titron hammer, Arca Plasmor shotgun, Arca Scisco scoped pistol, and the Arca armor set.
descriptions.zh: 弧电系列的武器代表着 Corpus 尖端的研究成果和制造工艺。这款组合包内包含弧电振子锤、弧电离子霰弹枪、带瞄准镜的弧电探知者手枪和弧电护甲套装。

descriptions.en: Energize your look with the full set of Porta decorative armor.
descriptions.zh: 用这套装饰护甲来为你的造型注入活力。

descriptions.en: Corpus craftsmanship applied to ancient principles creates this masterwork of defensive and aesthetic design. "Accept death, and escape it."
descriptions.zh: Corpus 工艺与古典原则的结合创造了这件兼具防御性和美学设计的杰作。"接受并逃脱死亡。"

descriptions.en: Profit from the latest in Corpus combat innovations. Contains the Stahlta rifle, Stropha gunblade and Shi Armor set.
descriptions.zh: 得益于最新的 Corpus 战斗创新。包含钢刃步枪 、诡计之刃，以及死逝护甲套装。

descriptions.en: Derived from Corpus protective technology, the Dendra decorative armor provides a unique look for any Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 起源于 Corpus 的防护技术，登德拉护甲提供给任何战甲一个独特的外观。

descriptions.en: This set of mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
descriptions.zh: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了 Corpus 的设计美感。

descriptions.en: Master market forces with this collection of Corpus items. Includes the electrified Ohma Melee Weapon, Quaro Armor Set, Quaro Sugatra, and Sovereign Outcast Stance.
descriptions.zh: 用这组 Corpus 物品组合包掌控市场力量。其中包含带电的欧玛近战武器、求知护甲套装、求知坠饰和至尊浪人架式。

descriptions.en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
descriptions.zh: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。

descriptions.en: Dazzle friends and enemies alike, with this armor’s solar brilliance.
descriptions.zh: 这套护甲的太阳光辉让朋友和敌人都为之眩目。

descriptions.en: Nothing helps getting through Defense waves like a Dethcube. Also included are some customization options and an affinity booster to make your weekend even better.
descriptions.zh: 没有什么能比的上死亡魔方在防御战中提供的帮助。此外，这个特惠还包含了一些自定义外观与经验值加成，让你的周末更加美满。

names.zh: 死亡魔方周末活动特惠

descriptions.en: You are pestilence and plague with the Deimos Infested Bundle. Includes the Zymos Pistol, Keratinos Claws, and Sordario Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过火卫二感染组合包来成为最致命的肆虐瘟疫。包括邪莫斯手枪、卡提努之爪和心瘤披饰。

descriptions.en: New weapons have emerged from the seething horror of the Infestation, each bringing a fresh, living aspect to their power. Featuring the bile-loaded Catabolyst Pistol, Proboscis Cernos Bow, Pulmonars Nunchaku, and the devastating Bubonico Arm Cannon.
descriptions.zh: 全新的武器已从感染者恐怖的攻击浪潮中浮现，每一把武器都带来了崭新的气象。拥有胆汁装填的异化者（手枪类武器）、刺吸西诺斯（弓类武器）、感染连枷（ 双截棍类武器）和毁灭性的横痃重炮（手炮类武器）。

descriptions.en:
For a limited time, begin your journey to the Heart of Deimos with a bang! Get instant access to exclusive Customizations today.

Deimos Neophyte Supporter Pack features:

- Thelyphon Whip Skin:  Equally as elegant as it is ferocious, this mace-tipped whip skin is sure to leave an impression.
- Capstan In Action Glyph: A Glyph featuring the Capstan Pistol Skin in action!
- Domestik Carrion Drone: An Infested stowaway, now content to wander your Orbiter.
- Festering Ephemera: Pestilent sores and bubbles burst with your every move.
descriptions.zh:
在有限的时间内，轰轰烈烈地开启你前往火卫二腹地的旅途吧！今天即刻获取专属的自定义装饰。

火卫二新手支援包内含：

- 鞭蝎鞭类外观：兼具优雅与残忍，这款尖端带刺的鞭子外观一定会给人留下深刻印象。
- 绞盘战斗姿态浮印：描绘着绞盘手枪外观战斗姿态的浮印。
- 腐肉内务无人机：一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的 Infested，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。
- 溃脓幻纹： 致命的脓包随着你的一举一动而膨胀爆裂。

descriptions.en:
For a limited time, begin your journey to the Heart of Deimos with a bang! Get instant access to exclusive Customizations today.

Deimos Hive Supporter Pack features:

- 570 Platinum
- Thelyphon Whip Skin:  Equally as elegant as it is ferocious, this mace-tipped whip skin is sure to leave an impression.
- Zobov Shotgun Skin: The favored weapon of the Entrati, this Skin bestows your Shotgun with an otherworldly luster.
- Khrusos Syandana: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
- Capstan In Action Glyph: A Glyph featuring the Capstan Pistol Skin in action!
- Domestik Carrion Drone: An Infested stowaway, now content to wander your Orbiter.
- Festering Ephemera: Pestilent bubbles swell and burst with your every move.
descriptions.zh:
在有限的时间内，轰轰烈烈地开启你前往火卫二腹地的旅途吧！今天即刻获取专属的自定义装饰。

火卫二虫巢支援包内含：

- 570 白金
- 鞭蝎鞭类外观：兼具优雅与残忍，这款尖端带刺的鞭子外观一定会给人留下深刻印象。
- 巨洞霰弹枪外观：Entrati 钟爱的武器，这款外观能够赋予你的霰弹枪以异界的光泽。
- 金蛹披饰：宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。
- 绞盘战斗姿态浮印：描绘着绞盘手枪外观战斗姿态的浮印。
- 腐肉内务无人机：一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的 Infested，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。
- 溃脓幻纹： 致命的脓包随着你的一举一动而膨胀爆裂。

descriptions.en:
For a limited time, begin your journey to the Heart of Deimos with a bang! Get instant access to exclusive Customizations today.

Deimos Swarm Supporter Pack features:

- 1200 Platinum
- Thelyphon Whip Skin:  Equally as elegant as it is ferocious, this mace-tipped whip skin is sure to leave an impression.
- Zobov Shotgun Skin: The favored weapon of the Entrati, this Skin bestows your Shotgun with an otherworldly luster.
- Capstan Pistol Skin: The hammer falls, the cylinder turns, and the cycle begins once again. Flawless machinery moving in sequence.
- Khrusos Syandana: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
- Paradiso Armor Plates: Seemingly infused with mystical power, the chosen Armor of graceful warriors.
- Capstan In Action Glyph
- Domestik Carrion Drone
- Festering Ephemera
descriptions.zh:
在有限的时间内，轰轰烈烈地开启你前往火卫二腹地的旅途吧！今天即刻获取专属的自定义装饰。

火卫二虫群支援包内含：

- 1200 白金
- 鞭蝎鞭类外观：兼具优雅与残忍，这款尖端带刺的鞭子外观一定会给人留下深刻印象。
- 巨洞霰弹枪外观：Entrati 钟爱的武器，这款外观能够赋予你的霰弹枪以异界的光泽。
- 绞盘手枪外观：锤落筒转，周而复始。无瑕的机械在依序运转。
- 金蛹披饰：宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。
- 乐境护甲套装：似乎被注入了神秘的力量，这是优雅的战士们所选择的护甲。
- 绞盘战斗姿态浮印
- 腐肉内务无人机
- 溃脓幻纹外观

descriptions.en: Transcend the chaos of battle. Baruuk Shaoshi's mystic runes show him the path to peace.
descriptions.zh: 超越战火的混乱。Baruuk 少室的神秘符文为他指明了通往和平的道路。

descriptions.en: Baruuk Doan is the calm center of a chaotic storm. This collection includes the Baruuk Doan Skin, Harmatt Sparring Skin, and Khinn Syandana.
descriptions.zh: Baruuk 铃僧代表着混乱风暴中心的那份平静。组合包内含 Baruuk 铃僧外观、沙寂搏击外观和经行披饰。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly into the Otherworld with Caliban Orfeo. His collection includes the Caliban Orfeo Skin, Seighe Venato Skin, Heurodis Ephemera, and Heurodis Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Caliban 奥菲欧勇闯异世界。他的组合包内含 Caliban 奥菲欧外观、见战脉纹外观和尤丽迪茜幻纹。

descriptions.en: Light the flame of eternal love with Citrine Aphrodita.
descriptions.zh: 用 Citrine 美神点燃永恒之爱的火焰。

descriptions.en: Kindle Ember's elemental fire in its most refined form yet. Includes Ember Pyraxis Skin, Volca Syandana and Flamethrower Plazm Skin.
descriptions.zh: Ember 的元素之火以其最精炼的形式点燃。内含 Ember 燃烬外观，熔焰披饰，以及火焰喷射器炎浆外观。

descriptions.en: Kick into high gear with the Gauss Moto Collection. The Saint of Altra enters a new era.
descriptions.zh: Gauss 摩托系列，助你火力全开。阿尔特拉圣者步入全新时代。

descriptions.en: Go full throttle with Gauss Kresnik. His fiery collection includes the Gauss Kresnik Skin, Bolide Syandana, and Acceltra Caduceus Skin.
descriptions.zh: 用 Gauss 火神全速前进。他那火一般的组合包内含 Gauss 火神外观、火流星披饰以及迅发电浆炮 双蛇外观。

descriptions.en: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis: keep this inseparable odd couple together forever.
descriptions.zh: Gauss 摩托和 Grendel 暴坦：让这对形影不离的奇特组合永远在一起。

descriptions.en: Gain new appreciation for mastication with the Grendel Turbis collection. Those who see what lies within his gaping maw rarely live to tell the tale.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Grendel 暴坦系列，重新领略咀嚼的真谛。能亲眼目睹他巨口深处的人，鲜少能活下来讲述这段经历。

descriptions.en: Gyre crackles to life in this collection themed around archaic experimental technology.
descriptions.zh: 在这个以古老的实验技术为主题的组合包中，Gyre 充满了活力。

descriptions.en: Hildryn arises anew, re-forged in the fires of finest smith-craft. Add splendor to her saga with this collection of deluxe items. Includes the Hildryn Einheri Skin, Blodgard Heavy Blade Skin and the Brising Syandana.
descriptions.zh: Hildryn 在工匠之火中淬炼重生。用这款华丽组合包为她的传奇故事增光添彩。内含 Hildryn 英灵外观、血卫巨刃外观，以及煦珀披饰。

descriptions.en: Transform the captive Warframe’s burden of blame into a smoldering mark of pride with this collection of Apostate skins and items.
descriptions.zh: 使用叛徒外观和物品组合包，将被囚禁战甲背负的自责转化为骄傲的燃烧印记。

descriptions.en: Master the art of transmutation with this collection of skins and items for Lavos Khymia.
descriptions.zh: 掌握炼制术之奥秘——Lavos 点金外观与装备组合包。

descriptions.en: Explore the realms of Sentient design with these skins for Volt and Mesa, showing them as they would have appeared if the Sentients had created them.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些为 Volt 和 Mesa 打造的外观来探索 Sentient 的设计领域，该组合包展示了他们若是由 Sentient 创造将会拥有的样貌。

names.zh: Sentient 视界华丽外观组合包

descriptions.en: Infuse your style with the grace of drifting sakura petals. This bundle includes Nova Aozakura’s signature accessories.
descriptions.zh: 让飘舞的樱花花瓣为你的风格增添优雅气息。此组合包内含 Nova 蓝樱的标志性配件。

descriptions.en: Choose the path of wisdom with the Dante Tytonis Collection. His dark wings harbor secret knowledge and arcane power.
descriptions.zh: 使用 Dante 夜鹰组合包，踏上智慧之路。他那幽暗的羽翼蕴藏着不为人知的知识和神秘的力量。

descriptions.en: Protea Caladrius disheartens enemies as she emboldens her allies. This collection includes the Protea Caladrius Skin, Daecret Tonkor Skin, and Monitivus Thrown Weapon Skin.
descriptions.zh: Protea 医官鸟在给盟友壮胆的同时让敌人灰心丧气。这款组合包内含 Protea 医官鸟外观、征服榴炮圣裁外观和投掷武器警世外观。
驱散邪恶。Qorvex 圣殿以他的骇人身姿令那些企图恐吓他人之徒不寒而栗。

descriptions.en: Dwell in the eternal twilight with Revenant’s haunting Mephisto collection.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Revenant 令人不安的梅菲斯特组合包栖身九界间的永恒黄昏中。

descriptions.en: Take on a touch of the devil with these Revenant Mephisto Operator accessories.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些 Revenant 梅菲斯特指挥官配件来感受一丝恶魔的气息。

names.zh: Revenant 梅菲斯特指挥官组合包

descriptions.en: Turn legend into reality. This collection includes Sevagoth Glaukus, his loyal companion Bosun Gillychap, a custom Tombstone, and the Cirriped Epitaph Skin. It also features Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow in combat and can be played on the Somachord in your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 把传说变为现实。该组合包内含 Sevagoth 格劳克斯、他的忠实同伴水手长吉利鱼、一个可自定义的墓碑、以及葬铭蔓足外观。它还包括 Sevagoth 的安眠曲——一首在战斗中为 Sevagoth 的幽影播放的自定歌曲，该曲目也可在轨道飞行器中使用身心和弦琴播放。

descriptions.en: The warrior spirit reincarnates in the image of a god. His collection includes the Tequihua Polearm Skin, Huitzilin Syandana, and Chimalli & Tequihua Decoration for your Orbiter.
descriptions.zh: 战士精神以神明的形象转世。他的组合包内含战矛长柄武器外观、蜂鸟灵披饰，以及战盾 & 战矛轨道飞行器装饰。

descriptions.en: Assume the lethal form of a lustrous midnight. This collection includes the Titania Donann skin, Titania's Moyturan Wings, the Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin, the Hawth Diwata Skin, and the Raylta Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 化身为皎洁之夜的致命形态。该组合包内含 Titania 大地女神外观、Titania 莫伊图兰翅膀、 Dex 妖精空灵外观、仙女赤爪外观，以及星翼披饰。

descriptions.en: Fear and awe will be seen in your enemies’ eyes when they behold the great berserker. Her collection includes the Valkyr Carnivex Skin, Dreyric Fist Skin, and Alastorn Armor.
descriptions.zh: 当伟大的狂战士出现时，你将从敌人的眼中看到恐惧和敬畏。这款组合包内含 Valkyr 行刑者外观、沁血拳套外观，以及魔使护甲。

descriptions.en: Claim attire forged to conquer the storm. This bundle includes Volt Raijin’s signature accessories.
descriptions.zh: 获取为征服风暴而打造的装束。此组合包内含 Volt 雷帝的标志性配件。

descriptions.en: Beauty meets chaos. This collection includes accessories for both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
descriptions.zh: 美感与混沌的交融。此组合包内含 Volt 雷帝和 Nova 蓝樱的配件。

descriptions.en: Embody the fury of the storm and the grace of sakura petals that float upon the water. This collection includes both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
descriptions.zh: 体现风暴的狂怒和樱花花瓣漂浮在水面上的优雅。该组合包内含 Volt 雷帝和 Nova 蓝樱。

descriptions.en: Invoke Voruna Medeina, the forest goddess. Her savagery is a blessing to those who hunger for justice.
descriptions.zh: 祈求森林女神 Voruna 梅迪娜的庇佑。她的狂野对渴望正义的人来说是一种祝福。

descriptions.en: Natural and preternatural combine in Wisp Somnium. This collection includes the Wisp Somnium Skin, Subvolv Syandana, and Privolv Fulmin Skin.
descriptions.zh: Wisp 星梦是自然与超自然的结合体。该组合包包括 Wisp 星梦外观、月阳披饰和月阴雷霆外观。

descriptions.en: Embark upon an epic journey with this collection of skins and items for Wukong Qitian.
descriptions.zh: 与这套 Wukong 齐天大圣外观及物品组合包一同踏上史诗之旅。

descriptions.en:
The Void reimagines broken Orokin treasures. In these manifestations of Xaku’s memories, remnants of warfare meet fragments of artistry. The collection includes Xaku Kagura, Lotus Amaga, the Lohk’s Embrace Ephemera, Xaku and Lotus Mended Glyphs, and Gallixware ceramic decorations for your Orbiter.

Complete The New War Quest to unlock Lotus customization.
descriptions.zh:
虚空重塑了破碎的奥罗金珍宝。在 Xaku 记忆所生成的显化中，战争的残响与艺术的碎片相遇。本系列组合包内含 Xaku 神乐外观、天女 Lotus 外观、虚空之拥幻纹、Xaku 和 Lotus 复苏浮印，以及为轨道飞行器定制的高力士陶瓷装饰。

需要完成《新纪之战》系列任务来解锁 Lotus 的自定义装饰。

descriptions.en: Strike forth from the watery depths with the power of Yareli Pandea. Her collection includes the Yareli Pandea Skin, Nidoblast Kompressa Skin, Rubra Sugatra, Merulina Pandea Skin and the Merulina Pandea Domestik Drone.
descriptions.zh: 借助 Yareli 盘古底的力量从水深之处发起攻击。她的组合包内含 Yareli 盘古底外观、刺触卡帕压力枪外观、赤蜇坠饰、浪漪珊瑚盘古底外观和浪漪珊瑚盘古底内务无人机。

descriptions.en: Soar to new heights as Zephyr with this turbocharged deluxe collection. Includes Zephyr Harrier Skin, Arclite Landing Craft Skin and Zephyr Harrier Theme.
descriptions.zh: 用这款涡轮增压的华丽外观来让 Zephyr 翱翔在新的高度。包含 Zephyr 鹞式外观、弧光登陆艇外观和 Zephyr 鹞式主题。

descriptions.en: A bold, radical look that tells everyone you rule the skies. Includes Harrier Suit, Harrier Sleeves, Harrier Leggings, and Harrier Hood. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 通过大胆、激进的造型来告诉大家你是天空的主宰。包括鹞式套服、鹞式袖件、鹞式绑腿和鹞式头罩。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en:
This bundle offers unparalleled opportunity for maximum destruction.

It includes the Elytron Archwing, perfect for the demolition specialist, and comes outfitted with the powerful Onorix axe and Corvas cannon.
descriptions.zh:
为达到最高的破坏力，这个组合包提供了前所未有的一个机会。

内含的鞘翅曲翼，完美地专精于破坏，并配备了强悍的奥努里克斯战斧与黑鸦加农炮。

descriptions.en: A desert camouflage skin pack for your Grineer arsenal.
descriptions.zh: 为你呈现 Grineer 军械库的沙漠迷彩外观包。

descriptions.en: A collection of glyphs created by artists in the Warframe community.
descriptions.zh: 一组来自 Warframe 社区的艺术家创作的浮印。

descriptions.en: Bring home the familiar faces of the Devil’s Triad - whether friends or enemies, now cuddly for your convenience!
descriptions.zh: 把《恶魔三重奏》中熟悉的面孔带回家——无论是朋友还是敌人，现在都变成了适合拥抱的可爱玩偶！

names.zh: 软萌三重奏玩偶组合包

descriptions.en: An entire set of Gazal armor.
descriptions.zh: 一整套加扎勒护甲

descriptions.en: Become wrapped in mystery with complete set of Gazal skins and armor. Includes bonus Djinn Sentinel.
descriptions.zh: 用一整套加扎勒外观和护甲来变得神秘，包含额外的引灵守护。

descriptions.en: Keep the Orbiter in spotless condition with the latest in Corpus sanitation technology.
descriptions.zh: 使用 Corpus 最先进的卫生科技来维持一尘不染的轨道飞行器环境。

descriptions.en: Dual Ether and the dual-wielded Afuris in one special weekend package. Add in a bonus Affinity Booster to double the speed of leveling them up.
descriptions.zh: 苍穹双剑以及双持盗贼双枪就在这特别的周末组合包中！附带的经验值加成道具让您的升级速度倍增！

descriptions.en: Get the Chroma Warframe and the latest weaponry to hit the market, along with boosters to level your new gear faster!
descriptions.zh: 取得 Chroma 战甲与最新上市的武器，组合包内含加成道具使您的装备升级更加快速！

descriptions.en: Dress your Kaithe as Rakhali, Dagath's noble steed. This collection includes the Aumen Chamfron, Saddle, and Tail.
descriptions.zh: 把你的绝灵骥打扮成 Dagath 的高贵骏马拉卡里。其中包含金兆马盔、马鞍和马尾。

descriptions.en: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SAMPOTES）喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。

descriptions.en: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SYAM）业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。

descriptions.en:
Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

When purchased in the Market this Duviri melee weapon will be available for immediate Warframe use in the Arsenal and for the Drifter in Duviri.
descriptions.zh:
（英文：ARGO & VEL）星舟 & 帆为坚忍不拔的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。

在游戏内商店购买这把双衍王境近战武器后，它将立即可供军械库中的战甲使用，同时也可供双衍王境中的漂泊者使用。

descriptions.en: Edun befits dexterous warriors. Power Strike knocks down and blinds enemies by surrounding them with a cloud of dust.
descriptions.zh: （英文：EDUN）雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。使用强力攻击激起一团环绕敌人的尘雾，从而击倒并致盲他们。

descriptions.en: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击数。

descriptions.en: Stride into the fray with fractal elegance.

descriptions.zh: 一个双衍王境主题组合包，内含一个由社区艺术家制作的浮印和展示图。

descriptions.en:
The Murmur continues to scrape deeper into our realm of existence. Having devised a solution to detect such whispers, Fibonacci won't allow such trespassing to threaten our system.

This Operation relies on Tenno across the Origin System to construct an invisible ‘living defense' against the growing Murmur threat. Players must have completed the Whispers in the Walls Quest to participate!

How to play:

To join this living defense, or ‘Murmur Telemetry Chorus,' you must hunt down the power source that'll continuously power your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle.

1. Go to your Dojo and build the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle from your Dojo Decorations. Only one Gargoyle can be built per Dojo, so if you don't see it in your Decoration list, your Clan Members may have already placed it!

2. Play Effervo on Deimos to earn Operation rewards. Players must successfully defeat both the Void Angel and the Assassination Target in-mission to earn one of the following:
  • Curse of Knowing (The Fragmented Suzerain)
  • Curse of Seeing (The Fragmented Anchorite)
  • Curse of Hearing (The Fragmented Zelator)

Earn 1 Curse per Normal Path mission, or double of the same Curse on Steel Path.

Successfully defeating the Assassination Target also rewards Grotesque Splinters. 

3. Return to your Dojo and feed the Curses to your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle every week to contribute to a Clan Trophy. Contribute Curses each week to hit the Cap and improve your Clan Scoring -- resulting in better Trophies at the end!

4. Visit the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle to exchange Grotesque Splinters for various Operation rewards!
descriptions.zh:
低语者继续深入侵蚀我们存在的领域。斐波那契已经设计出一种检测这些低语者的方法，决不允许这样的侵入威胁我们的星系。

这项行动需要始源星系中的 Tenno 们共同建立一道看不见的"活跃的防御工事"，以应对日益增长的低语者威胁。玩家必须完成《墙中低语》系列任务才能参与！

如何游玩：

要加入这种活跃的防御工事，或称为"低语者遥测合声"，你需要找到可以为警戒形态合成兽像持续供能的能量源。

1. 前往道场并从道场装饰中建造警戒形态合成兽像。每个道场只能建造一尊合成兽像，如果你在装饰列表中看不到它，可能是你的氏族成员已经放置了它！

2. 在火卫二恶涌上游玩来获取行动奖励。玩家必须在任务中成功击败虚空天使和刺杀目标来获取以下物品之一：
  • 认知诅咒（接肢宗主）
  • 视觉诅咒（接肢隐士）
  • 听觉诅咒（接肢信徒）

每完成一次普通任务，可获得 1 个诅咒，或者在钢铁之路上获得两倍同样的诅咒。

成功击败刺杀目标还将奖励怪异碎片。 

3. 返回你的道场，每周向你的警戒形态合成兽像喂食诅咒，以助于氏族奖杯的贡献。每周贡献诅咒以达到上限，并提高氏族分数——从而在最后获得更好的奖杯！

4. 拜访警戒形态合成兽像，用怪异碎片换取各种行动奖励！

descriptions.en:
Boost your Arsenal instantly with the new Ember Starter Pack, including a Warframe, Customizations and many more powerful items. Light the Origin System aflame with Ember's Abilities and Essential Heat Damage Mods. Get the Ember Starter Pack and burn away the opposition today!

Pack Includes:
- Ember Warframe
- Ember Phoenix Helmet
- Nikana Weapon
- Essential Heat Damage Mod Bundle

One per account. Available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
通过全新的 Ember 入门组合包立即增强你的军械库，组合包内含一款战甲、自定义装饰，以及更多强力物品！用 Ember 的技能和基础火焰伤害 Mod 来点燃整个始源星系。立即获取 Ember 入门组合包并将对手烧成灰烬！

组合包内含：
- Ember 战甲
- Ember 凤凰头盔
- 侍刃武器
- 火焰伤害 Mod 基础组合包

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

Fight an eternal battle for the future with Vena, the blood-loving fanatic, and Ryoku, the cool and calculating killer. Two bitter rivals brought together in this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins. 

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.

与嗜血狂热者维纳和冷静狡黠的杀手忍力一同，为未来展开一场永恒之战。这两位宿敌将在这组原型战甲双子外观中并肩作战。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en:
Show your Xbox One allegiance with the all-new Prestige Pack X!
Gear up with this exclusive set of Jade Axa Armor, the next-generation armor for your Warframe.

Prestige Pack X includes:
- Jade Axa Chest Plate
- Jade Axa Shoulder Plates
- Jade Axa Leg Plates
- 170 Platinum

This Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.

descriptions.en: Crack the whip and release the Kavat with this vicious collection. Includes the Khora Warframe, Dual Keres swords, Hystrix quill gun, Kerata Syandana, and the Khora Delphi helmet.
descriptions.zh: 用这款凶恶的组合包来制造鞭击并释放出库娃。里面包括了 Khora 战甲、凯瑞斯双刀、豪猪飞镖枪、聚集披饰、和 Khora 德尔斐头盔。

descriptions.en:
Embody the galaxy’s most dangerous flora with the Urushu Collection. Includes the Khora Urushu Skin, the Veratria Blade and Whip Skin, the Pulchranopsis Syandana, and the Maculatia Skin for Venari or your other favorite Kavat.

Includes Khora Urushu Agile and Noble animation sets.
descriptions.zh:
漆花组合包涵盖了星系内最危险的植物。内含 Khora 漆花外观、藜芦剑鞭外观，秀兰披饰，以及适用于薇娜丽或其他你喜欢的库娃的毒参外观。

内含 Khora 漆花迅捷站姿和 Khora 漆花尊贵站姿。

descriptions.en: Repaired with golden-alloys, these battle-scarred weapons have been transformed into objects of beauty. Contains skins for the Braton, Paris, Kunai, Lato, Aklato, Skana and Bo.
descriptions.zh: 利用金色合金修复后，这些战痕累累的武器已经转化为优美的物件。组合包中包含布莱顿、帕里斯、苦无、拉托、空刃和玻之武杖的外观。

descriptions.en: Provides basic masking options for a Kubrow's innate DNA structure, allowing coat color customization.
descriptions.zh: 提供给库狛的天生 DNA 结构用的基础版遮蔽选项，让你能自定义库狛的颜色。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Doveran Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其道维然祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

descriptions.en: Customize a Kubrow's fur color with these isolated DNA sequences.
descriptions.zh: 使用这些独立的基因序列来自定义库狛的皮毛外观。

descriptions.en: Fur pattern matching your Kubrow's Heino ancestors, from a gene-line preserved by Kubrow master Skvirl. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winner]
descriptions.zh: 与库狛的海诺祖先匹配的毛皮花纹，来自库狛大师 Skvirl 保存下来的一个基因序列 。[Tenno 之友比赛冠军]

descriptions.en: The Orokin engineered this DNA structure to make their Kubrows embody the season of renewal.
descriptions.zh: 奥罗金设计了这种 DNA 结构，让他们的库狛体现季节的更新。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

names.zh: 钻石响尾蛇基因伪装包

descriptions.en: This mastiff can take it, and dish it out.
descriptions.zh: 这条獒犬既能承受打击，也能造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Euleria Entrati commissioned this unique Kubrow DNA segment to manifest a creature from the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
descriptions.zh: 欧拉瑞娅·英择谛定制了这个独特的库狛 DNA 模块来实体化《双衍王境故事集》中的一种生物。

descriptions.en: First silence, then the snapping of a twig, then death.
descriptions.zh: 先是寂静无声，后是树枝折断的声音，再后就是死亡。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Averal Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其挨维奥祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.en: This tool modifies the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and alter the fur pattern to this unique style.
descriptions.zh: 这件工具能够改变库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹转变为这种独特的风格。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Telmatian Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其大麦町祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Savenga Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其赛凡咖祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.en: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Tigrol Kubrow ancestors.
descriptions.zh: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其虎古尔祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

descriptions.en: Raise a prize-winning companion with this fur-patterning for Kubrow and Kavat. Contains both the Heino Kubrow Fur Pattern and Deaeira Kavat Fur Pattern. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winners]
descriptions.zh: 用这款毛皮花纹来培育一只足以赢得选美大奖的库狛和库娃吧。此组合包同时包含海诺库狛毛皮花纹和狄尔拉库娃毛皮花纹。[Tenno 之友比赛冠军]

descriptions.en:
Contains all of the components to begin gene-splicing a Kubrow!

Requires: Installed Incubator Segment
descriptions.zh:
包含了一切开始库狛的基因拼接所必要的组件！

需要：安装好的孵化器模块

descriptions.en: A full set of Kuva Armor.
descriptions.zh: 一整套赤毒护甲。

descriptions.en: Become Grineer royalty with this complete set of Kuva weapons and armor. Includes the Zarr cannon, Kesheg halberd, Twin Rogga pistols, as well as the fearsome Kuva Armor, Kuva Cloak and Kuva Cord. This bundle also features four Kuva landing craft skins and Kuva Kubrow and Kavat Armor.
descriptions.zh: 以这组赤毒武器和护甲组来效忠 Grineer。组合包内含沙皇火炮、怯薛长戟、双子罗格手枪，以及可怕的赤毒护甲、赤毒斗篷和赤毒绳结。同时附送四款赤毒登陆艇外观、库狛和库娃专用的赤毒护甲。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Start Anew Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以万象更新组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Blessing & Fortune Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以福禄双全组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Luminous Brilliance Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 以璀璨光华组合包庆贺农历新年。

descriptions.en: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this selection of special items.
descriptions.zh: 虎年新春到！通过一系列精选的特殊物品来庆祝这一古老的节日。

descriptions.en: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this hoard of splendid treats.
descriptions.zh: 虎年新春到！通过各种好物来庆祝这一古老的节日。

descriptions.en: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this set of exquisite treasures.
descriptions.zh: 虎年新春到！通过这套奇珍异宝来庆祝这一古老的节日。

descriptions.en: Bring in the blessings of a new lunar year with this custom theme, background and sigil!
descriptions.zh: 通过这款包含了自定义界面主题、背景以及纹章的组合包带来新春祝福！

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. The contents of this bundle are imbued with peace and comfort.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。愿这个组合包中的内容为你带来平安与健康。

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. Good fortune is sure to come your way as you make use of the items in this bundle.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地庆祝新年。当你使用这个组合包中的物品时，好运就会降临。

descriptions.en: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. This bundle makes for a spectacular celebration.
descriptions.zh: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。让这个组合包为你带来一场盛大的庆典。

descriptions.en: Invite good fortune with the Chroma Zunlong Floof and Nukor Lunaeus Skin.
descriptions.zh: 让 Chroma 尊龙玩偶和努寇微波枪岁朝外观为你带来好运。

descriptions.en: Ring in prosperity with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Dual Swords Lunaeus Skin, Baochun Sugatra, and Lunar Renewal Soar Sigil.
descriptions.zh: 用新春界面主题、双剑岁朝外观，报春坠饰以及新春龙翔纹章来迎接繁荣兴盛。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the year of the dragon with the Chroma Zunlong Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Emote, Ogris Skin, Sentinel Skin, and Sentinel Armor.
descriptions.zh: 用 Chroma 尊龙外观以及其附赠的幻纹、表情动作、食人女魔外观、守护外观，和守护护甲来欢庆龙年。

descriptions.en: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry.
descriptions.zh: 装扮守护，共舞新春华章。

descriptions.en: Invite good fortune with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Hespar Lunaeus Skin, Cordmade Sugatra, Mirage Nuwa Floof, and Lunar Renewal Snake Sigil.
descriptions.zh: 通过新春界面主题、暮斩岁朝外观、编绳坠饰、Mirage 女娲玩偶以及新春腾蛇纹章，来祈求好运！

descriptions.en: Ring in prosperity with the Mirage Nuwa Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Boltor Skin, Kavat Armor, and Floof.
descriptions.zh: 使用 Mirage 女娲外观及其配套的幻纹、螺钉步枪外观、库娃护甲和玩偶来喜迎蛇年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the year of the snake with everything in both the Smoky Quartz Bundle and the Pink Topaz Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 通过烟晶组合包和粉红托帕组合包中的所有物品来庆祝蛇年。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Year of the Horse in style with this equine collection.
descriptions.zh: 用这款与午马有关的组合包欢庆新春。

descriptions.en: Kindle the ghostly light of wrath with the Dagath Yfari Collection. The sight of her spectral cavalry strikes fear into the hearts of those with ill intent.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Dagath 伊法里组合包点燃愤怒的幽灵之光。她那幽灵般的骑兵，会让那些怀有恶意的人心生恐惧。

descriptions.en: This complete collection of Lunar Renewal skins and items is everything you need to rejoice in the turning of another year.
descriptions.zh: 这一整套新春外观与物品组合包，包含了庆祝新一年到来所需的全部物品。

descriptions.en: Get a taste of The Old Blood with this exclusive, one-time purchase, of Kuva Lich items. Includes a full set of Requiem Mods, the Radiant Requiem Relic Pack, Kuva Warframe Armor, and an assortment of Kuva Lich themed color pallets.
descriptions.zh: 通过这个关于赤毒玄骸物品的专属一次性购买来呷一口《远古之血》。包含有全套安魂 Mod、光辉安魂遗物组合包、赤毒战甲护甲以及各种赤毒玄骸主题调色盘。

descriptions.en:
The energy flowing within this sheath changes to match the blade within it. The Nikana will cause the energy to flow like the current of a river, while the Dragon Nikana causes the sheath to rage with molten fury.

This skin requires a Nikana or a Dragon Nikana to use.
descriptions.zh:
流动于刀鞘周围的能量会顺应武器的类型而改变。与「侍刃」一同装备时其刀鞘上的能量将如河水般流动，若与「龙之侍刃」一起装备则使刀鞘燃起炙烈的熔岩火花。

这项外观道具需要与「侍刃」或「龙之侍刃」搭配使用。

descriptions.en: Standing in the doorway between one world and another, be sure to cut a memorable figure. This bundle includes the Limina Limbo Skin, Tarock Thrown Weapon Skin, Interga Sugatra and the Sidereal Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 矗立于世界之间的出入口，务必得有一身让人难以忘怀的装扮。这款组合包内含 Limbo 阈限外观、投掷武器 塔罗外观、英特喀坠饰与恒星披饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Limbo in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Limbo Voidshell Skin and Lotus Pattern material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Limbo 虚空之壳外观以及 Lotus 花纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: A cache containing 25,000 Credits and 1,000 Endo.
descriptions.zh: 一个内装有 25,000 现金和 1,000 内融核心的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Guiding Rose Glyph, an Exilus Adapter and a 3 Day Affinity Booster.
descriptions.zh: 内含指路玫瑰浮印、一个特殊功能槽连接器和3天经验值加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing 3 Riven Mods with slots.
descriptions.zh: 内装有 3 张裂罅 Mod 的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Lustrous Major Glyph, an Orokin Reactor and a 7 Day Credit Booster.
descriptions.zh: 内含光耀卓越浮印，一个奥罗金反应堆和 7 天现金加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Imminent Eclipse Sigil, an Orokin Catalyst and an Affinity Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含日蚀将临纹章，一个奥罗金催化剂和经验值加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Awakened Luna Sigil, an Exilus Adapter and a Credit Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含月苏纹章，一个特殊功能槽连接器和现金加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Eternal Stasis Sigil, an Orokin Reactor and an Affinity Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含永世静态纹章，一个奥罗金反应堆和经验值加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Solar Flare Sigil, an Orokin Catalyst and a Credit Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含烈阳之焰纹章，一个奥罗金催化剂和现金加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Void Gate Sigil, an Exilus Adapter and an Affinity Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含虚空之门纹章，一个特殊功能槽连接器和经验值加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Lotus Deliverance Sigil, an Orokin Reactor and a Credit Booster.
descriptions.zh: 一个包含 LOTUS 救援纹章，一个奥罗金反应堆和现金加成的储藏箱。

descriptions.en: A cache containing the Spectral Tide Glyph, an Orokin Reactor and a Forma Bundle.
descriptions.zh: 内含光谱浪潮浮印、一个奥罗金反应堆和 一个 Forma 组合包的储藏箱

descriptions.en: Strike from the shadows with this collection of ill-gotten garb. Features the Loki Knave skin, Nari & Vali Skin for the Dual Kamas and Hulta armor set.
descriptions.zh: 用这套来路不正的外观从阴影中袭击，包含 Loki 无赖外观，双剑纳莉与瓦利外观和隐匿护甲套装。

descriptions.en: Unlock Loki and his favorite gear.
descriptions.zh: 解锁 Loki 和他的御用装备。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Loki in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Loki Voidshell Skin and the Murkray Scales material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Loki 虚空之壳外观以及阴暗鳐鳞纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: This ornate set of guards was worn by ancient Lunaro champions.
descriptions.zh: 这套华丽的防护套装是由古代月动球竞赛中的冠军所穿戴。

descriptions.en: Make your enemies fear you as they fear the dark. This bundle includes accessories inspired by The Wild Hunt of Naberus.
descriptions.zh: 让敌人像害怕黑暗一样害怕你。此组合包内含受纳贝流士狂猎启发的配件。

descriptions.en: Breathe new life into Mag with this collection of signature items. Includes the lavish Mag Pneuma Skin, Maruta Tonfa Skin, and the Vasa Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用这组标志性道具为 Mag 注入新的活力。包括了华贵的 Mag 元气外观、暴风拐刃外观，以及瓦萨披饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Mag in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mag Voidshell Skin and Soma Waves material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mag 虚空之壳外观以及胞体振波材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: A series 2 helmet for Excalibur, Frost, Loki, Rhino, Ash, Vauban, and Volt Warframes!
descriptions.zh: Excalibur，Frost，Loki，Rhino，Ash，Vauban，和 Volt的第二系列头盔！

descriptions.en: A collection of glyphs, using captured frames from the 100 Days of Warframe video by MASHED.
descriptions.zh: 一套浮印组合包，取材自 MASHED 制作的《百日 Warframe》视频。

descriptions.en: Cast a shadow of pure menace.
descriptions.zh: 投下充斥着纯粹威慑的暗影。

names.zh: 茛苕 Prime 护甲套装

descriptions.en: Inspired by the undulating design of the Anasa Ayatan sculpture, Ivara claims this as her signature armor set.
descriptions.zh: 受到了阿耶檀识 Anasa 塑像波浪线设计的启发，Ivara 声称这是她的标志性护甲套装。

names.zh: Anasa 阿耶檀识 Prime 护甲套装

descriptions.en: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en:
INSTANTLY UNLOCK ASH PRIME, AND PRIME GEAR!

Assemble the Prime Vanguard! For a limited time, you can purchase this pack and gain instant access to Ash Prime, Carrier Prime and more! Slots, Orokin Catalysts, and Orokin Reactors included.
descriptions.zh:
立即解锁 ASH PRIME，以及 PRIME 装备！

Prime 先锋部队集结！你可以在限定时间内购买这个组合包，来立即获取 Ash Prime、母舰 Prime，还有更多精彩物品！物品自带槽位、奥罗金催化剂，以及奥罗金反应堆。

descriptions.en:
INSTANTLY UNLOCK VAUBAN PRIME, ASH PRIME, AND PRIME GEAR!

Assemble the Prime Vanguard! For a limited time, you can purchase this pack and gain instant access to Vauban Prime, Ash Prime and more! Slots, Orokin Catalysts, and Orokin Reactors included.
descriptions.zh:
立即解锁 VAUBAN PRIME、ASH PRIME，以及 PRIME 装备！

Prime 先锋部队集结！你可以在限定时间内购买这个组合包，来立即获取 Vauban Prime、 Ash Prime，还有更多精彩物品！物品自带槽位、奥罗金催化剂，以及奥罗金反应堆。

names.zh: Vauban 和 Ash Prime 双重组合包

descriptions.en: Mesmerize enemies with Mirage Prime’s signature armor.
descriptions.zh: 用 Mirage Prime 的标志性护甲迷惑敌人。

names.zh: 返像 Prime 护甲套装

descriptions.en:
INSTANTLY UNLOCK ATLAS PRIME, AND PRIME GEAR!

Assemble the Prime Vanguard! For a limited time, you can purchase this pack and gain instant access to Atlas Prime, Dethcube Prime and more! Slots, Orokin Catalysts, and Orokin Reactors included.
descriptions.zh:
立即解锁 ATLAS PRIME 以及 PRIME 装备！

Prime 先锋部队集结！你可以在限定时间内购买这个组合包，来立即获取 Atlas Prime、死亡魔方 Prime，还有更多精彩物品！物品自带槽位、奥罗金催化剂，以及奥罗金反应堆。

descriptions.en:
INSTANTLY UNLOCK ATLAS PRIME, VAUBAN PRIME, AND PRIME GEAR!

Assemble the Prime Vanguard! For a limited time, you can purchase this pack and gain instant access to Atlas Prime, Vauban Prime and more! Slots, Orokin Catalysts, and Orokin Reactors included.

descriptions.en:
Konzu has a problem, a massive Infested Boil has broken through Earth's atmosphere, crashing down outside Cetus. As the boil grows, it spawns rabid Infested putting all life on the plains in jeopardy.

How to play:

Visit Konzu and initiate the Plague Star bounty
1. Head out onto the plains and find a Toxin Canister hidden within one of the Grineer caves
2. Take the canister to a mixing machine and defend the machine while it mixes 
3. Deposit the mixed toxin into a drone
4. Escort the drone to the boil
5. Kill off the Infested released from the boil. 

The Toxin can be augmented in two ways:
1. Eidolon Phylaxis can be created from a blueprint purchased from Nakak, and increases toxin lethality
2. Infested Catalyst is made in the Bio Lab in your clan's dojo, and causes the boil to spawn a massive Hemocyte

You must have Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst in your inventory to run the Advanced and Steel Path Bounties.
descriptions.zh:
孔尊遇到了麻烦，一个巨大的感染疖瘤突破了地球的大气层，坠落在希图斯外。随着疖瘤的生长，它产生了狂暴的感染者怪物，使得平野上的生命受到了严重威胁。

如何行动：

造访孔尊并开始瘟疫之星赏金任务
1. 前往平野并找到一个埋藏在 Grineer 把守的洞穴中的毒素罐
2. 携带着毒素罐前往混合器，并在毒素进行混合时防守机器
3. 将混合后的毒素放在一架无人机上
4. 护送无人机前往疖瘤
5. 杀死疖瘤释放出来的感染者

毒素有 2 种方式增强：
1. 夜灵抗体可以通过娜卡处买来的蓝图进行制作，可以增加毒素的杀伤力
2. Infested 催化剂可以通过氏族道场的生物实验室进行制造，可以诱使疖瘤创造一个巨型的免疫血胞体

你的仓库中必须同时拥有夜灵抗体和 Infested 催化剂才能进行进阶赏金任务和钢铁之路赏金任务。

descriptions.en:

我们都是从新手一步步走来的，Tenno。你有达到顶峰的能力吗？

descriptions.zh:
升级你的军械库来应对《新纪之战》！

对于任何想要提升自己实力的 Tenno 来说，《新纪之战》审判组合包是最具性价比之选。在限定的时间内，即刻把两款战甲外观、武器、自定义装饰、加成，以及更多精彩物品添加到你的军械库，以击退 Sentient 的入侵，并应对《新纪之战》。使用全新的源噬装备升级你的外观，该物品将在你游玩时解锁额外的自定义装饰。

组合包内含：
- 1700 白金
- 源噬幻纹
- 救赎者
- 掠骨枪刃外观*
- 合一众调色盘*
- 7 天经验值加成
- 7 天现金加成
- 执刑官混沌蛇主浮印*
- 执刑官混沌蛇主纹章*
- 源噬披饰
- Volt 电击使外观
- 源噬护甲套装
- Mesa 投射使外观
- 合一众三线琴
- Caliban 战甲
- 脉纹镰刀
- 灵噬披饰
- 孢噬坠饰

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 "*" 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

descriptions.en: A bundle containing displays of Marie, Lyon, and Roathe. Together, they form the Devil's Triad.
descriptions.zh: 包含玛丽、里昂和罗瑟展示图的组合包。三者共同构成恶魔三重奏。

descriptions.en: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
descriptions.zh: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念 Tenno 的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

descriptions.en:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被封印在石头里的虚空语叫声，对解开低语者的秘密至关重要。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The deepest of Voidtongue moans, etched into stone. An unlikely asset in the construction of Albrecht's vessels.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
被刻进石头中的深沉的虚空语哀鸣。意外地成为了一种建造阿尔布雷希特的承载体的资源。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
The quietest and most elusive of Voidtongue utterances. Sought after but never found by Albrecht.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)
descriptions.zh:
虚空语中最安静、最难以捉摸的话语。阿尔布雷希特一直在寻找却从未找到。

获取地点：阿尔布雷希特的实验室（火卫二）

descriptions.en:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
带刺且半真实，从一位虚空天使脱落。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使翅膀上的一片金属羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
虚空天使王冠上的精美羽毛。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
天才的象征，很久以前就从虚空天使身上掉落了。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman
descriptions.zh:
一根来自虚空天使的鲜活羽毛，在战斗中被扯了下来。

获取地点：扎里曼号

descriptions.en: Enjoy an eclectic variety of expressive designs. The Multiform Visage Ink Bundle includes Gneissic Visage Ink and all the designs from the Cloned Flesh, Taxmen, and Devotion Visage Ink Collections. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 享受不拘一格且富有表现力的样式。多样面部纹身墨水组合包内含漂泊者的片麻岩面部纹身墨水，以及来自复制肉体、税务官，挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包中的所有面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 多样面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Invest in self-expression. The Taxmen Visage Ink Collection includes Airlock, Collateral, Dividend, Futures, and Hull Breach Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 投资于自我表达。税务官面部纹身墨水组合包包含气闸、抵押、红利、期货和船裂面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 税务官面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en:
The Tales of Duviri storybook finds expression in these designs. The Paradox Visage Ink Collection includes Sharpshooter, Heavy Striker, Manipura, and Aru Visage Ink.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh:
《双衍王境故事集》中的故事在这些设计中得到了体现。悖论面部纹身墨水组合包内含神射手、猛力重击者、宝石和存在面部纹身墨水。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 悖论面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en:
Embrace the spirit of discovery. The Curiosity Visage Ink Collection includes Academe, Circuit, Kiai, and Verula Ink designs.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh:
拥抱探索精神。好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包内含学院、无尽回廊、气合和维鲁拉面部纹身图案。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Set yourself apart. The Cloned Flesh Visage Ink Collection includes Bulwark, Exome, Helix, Hunter, and Siege Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 让自己与众不同。复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包包括堡垒、外显子、螺旋、猎人和攻城面部纹身图案。 *面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Wear your heart on your sleeve. The Devotion Visage Ink Collection includes Affections, Amorous, Cherub, and Eros Struck Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 敞开你的心扉。挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包包括爱意、风情之花、小天使和爱神秋波面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。

names.zh: 挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包

descriptions.en: Take up the distinctive arms of the Dax of Tau with this collection of weapon skins.
descriptions.zh: 通过这套武器外观，体验 Tau 禁卫的独特武器。

names.zh: Tau 禁卫军备外观组合包

descriptions.en:
Deepen the bonds of camaraderie between the three unlikely companions of the Devil's Triad with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
descriptions.zh:
通过这组原型战甲双子外观，加深恶魔三重奏中三位看似不可能的伙伴之间的友谊。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

descriptions.en: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
descriptions.zh: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。

names.zh: 提奇鲁外观组合包 II

descriptions.en: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
descriptions.zh: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。

names.zh: 提奇鲁外观组合包 III

descriptions.en:
Discover a gruesome new playstyle with the Tempestarii Supporter Pack! This pack has everything you need to awaken your inner shadow, including discounted Platinum and more.

- 350 Platinum
- Sevagoth Warframe
- Vithil Syandana
- Lucifuge Helmet
- 30-Day Affinity Booster
- Forma Bundle

Limited-time offer. Only one per account.
descriptions.zh:
通过风暴使者支援包来探索令人毛骨悚然的全新玩法！这个组合包拥有让你的内在阴影觉醒所需要的一切，包括超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容。

- 350 白金
- Sevagoth 战甲
- 威丝披饰
- 避光头盔
- 30 天经验值加成
- Forma 组合包

限时发售。每个账号仅限购买一次。

descriptions.en: An anniversary-themed collection featuring a Glyph and two Displays made by community artists to celebrate 10 Years of Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 一个周年纪念主题的组合包，内含一个浮印和两个由社区艺术家制作的展示图，以此庆祝 Warframe 的十周年纪念。

names.zh: 十周年玩家社区艺术品组合包

descriptions.en: Enjoy Update 12 in style. This pack features the latest items, including the Zephyr Warframe and the deadly new weapons: Phage, Akstiletto and Jat Kittag. Rapidly level your new gear with the included 3-Day Experience and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 体验高大上的更新 12 吧。这个更新包的特色是最新的装备，包括 Zephyr 战甲和致命的新武器：噬菌者，史提托双枪和喷射战锤。为期三天的经验和现金加成让你迅速的升级你的新装备。

descriptions.en: Three colorful silken capes inspired by nature.
descriptions.zh: 三种受大自然启迪的丝质披饰。

descriptions.en: A stylish repertoire of weapons incorporating bladed designs for razor-sharp gunplay.
descriptions.zh: 一整组结合了刀片元素专为剃刀般锋利的枪战而设计的时尚武器。

descriptions.en: Explore the secrets of the forest. Includes the Titania Warframe and Titania Aurai Helmet, the razor-sharp Sarpa gunblade, the Pox infested darts and matching syandana. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.

descriptions.en: The trappings of royalty. Includes the deluxe Titania Empress Skin, Hawkmoth skin for the Dex Pixia exalted weapon, the Mot Skin for the Diwata sword, Titania's Heartwood Armor Set and the Dendrite Gunblade Skin.
descriptions.zh: 来自皇室的诱惑。此组合包内含 Titania 女皇华丽外观、显赫武器 DEX 妖精的天蛾外观、仙女长剑的莫特外观、Titania 的赤木护甲套装，以及树突枪刃外观。

descriptions.en: Broad swooping curves are the essence of the Nidina armor set.
descriptions.zh: 宽阔的曲线是尼迪纳护甲套装的精髓。

descriptions.en: Harden any look with this ultra sleek composite ceramic armor.
descriptions.zh: 以这套线条极为优美的复合陶瓷护甲来强化任何造型。

descriptions.en: Seemingly infused with mystical power, the chosen Armor of graceful warriors.
descriptions.zh: 似乎被注入了神秘的力量，这是优雅的战士们所选择的护甲。

descriptions.zh: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en:
Contains all of the components to begin gene-splicing a Vasca Kavat! Includes two specialized Vasca Imprints that combine during the incubation process to guarantee the generation of this rare sub-species.

Requires: Installed Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
descriptions.zh:
包含了一切开始噬血型库娃的基因拼接所必要的组件！包括两个特制的噬血型基因印记，在孵化阶段将其组合可确保诞生该稀有品种。

需要：安装好的库娃孵化器升级模块

names.zh: 噬血型库娃初心者套装

descriptions.en: Reinforce allies with this ingenious warrior. Contains the Vauban Citadel Skin, the Mortier Heavy Blade Skin, and the Marquis Sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 用这个灵巧的战士增援盟友。包含 Vauban 城塞外观，莫迪尔巨刃外观和侯爵坠饰。

descriptions.en: The perfect equipment for Tenno seeking the mysterious Orokin Vaults
descriptions.zh: 内含 Tenno 在探索神秘的奥罗金宝库时所需要的完美道具。

descriptions.en: A collection of a Glyph and Display created by artists in the Warframe Community.
descriptions.zh: 一组来自 Warframe 社区艺术家创作的浮印和展示图。

names.zh: 《破障者》社区艺术作品组合包

descriptions.en:
Stand by your brothers in arms and defend the defenseless with the items in this pack. Inspire courage with the For My Brothers Glyph, Kahl’s Fortitude Sigil, and Ascension Speargun Skin. Arm yourself with the powerful Slaytra, Afentis, and Aegrit Weapons. 

This pack features:

- 350 Platinum
- Slaytra Machete
- Afentis Speargun
- Ascension Speargun Skin
- Aegrit Thrown Weapon
- Fog of War Ephemera
- Kahl's Fortitude Sigil
- For My Brothers Glyph
- Noggle Statue - Kahl-175
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
- 7-Day Credit Booster

This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
descriptions.zh:
与你的兄弟并肩作战，使用这个组合包中的物品来保护手无寸铁之人。通过“为了我的兄弟们”浮印、Kahl 之刚毅纹章，以及飞升标枪外观来由内而发激发勇气；并使用强大的武器屠煞、圣英和骇敌来武装自己。

组合包内含：

- 350 白金
- 屠煞砍刀
- 圣英标枪
- 飞升标枪外观
- 骇敌投掷武器
- 战争迷雾幻纹
- Kahl 之刚毅纹章
- 为了我的兄弟们浮印
- Kahl-175 摇头娃娃
- 7 天经验值加成
- 7 天现金加成

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Excalibur Voidshell Skin, Nova Voidshell Skin, Wukong Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Excalibur 虚空之壳外观、Nova 虚空之壳外观、Wukong 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: A collection of Glyphs from renowned fantasy artist, Pete Venters.
descriptions.zh: 来自著名梦幻作品艺术家 Pete Venters 的浮印系列。

descriptions.en: Up your chances of making it on the Vallis with this collection of experimental Corpus weaponry: the Battacor Rifle, Ocucor Pistol and Kreska Ice Pick.
descriptions.zh: 用这个 Corpus 实验性武器组合包来增加你在山谷上生存下来的几率：武使之力步枪、视使之触手枪，以及直镐冰镐。

descriptions.en: A collection of glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 内含一套浮印的组合包。

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mag Voidshell Skin, Frost Voidshell Skin, Grendel Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mag 虚空之壳外观、Frost 虚空之壳外观、Grendel 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Limbo Voidshell Skin and Mesa Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Limbo 虚空之壳外观、Mesa 虚空之壳外观、以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mirage Voidshell Skin, Nidus Voidshell Skin and Protea Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mirage 虚空之壳外观、Nidus 虚空之壳外观，和 Protea 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: Make the most of the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Banshee Voidshell Skin, Loki Voidshell Skin, Nekros Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.
descriptions.zh: 充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Banshee 虚空之壳外观、Loki 虚空之壳外观、Nekros 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

descriptions.en: Claim the Void-touched Weapons wielded by Thrax Centurion and Legatus as your own.
descriptions.zh: 将凶魂百夫长和凶魂副将含有虚空之力的武器据为己有。

descriptions.en: Charge up Volt with this collection of items that includes the Volt Proto Skin, Diode Hammer Skin, and Cathode Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款道具组合包将 Volt 充满电能，包括了 Volt 原型外观、二极管战锤外观和阴极披饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Volt in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Volt Voidshell Skin and the Crimzian Opulence material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Volt 虚空之壳外观以及奢华绯红石材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Voruna in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Voruna Voidshell Skin and Rough Cryotic material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Voruna 虚空之壳外观以及永冻晶矿糙纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: One shot, one kill. Add in credit and affinity boosters to maximize your weekend hunting. This weekend only.
descriptions.zh: 一枪一个！加上现金与经验值加成，以最大限度提高你的周末猎杀，只限本周！

descriptions.en:
Recall buried battlefield memories with this collection of ancient mementos. Some things ought never be forgotten.

The Klebrik Scaffold, Granmu Prism and Lohrin Brace are Amp components that can be assembled within the Quill cave.
descriptions.zh:
通过这套古老的纪念品唤起尘封已久的战场记忆。有些事永远不应被遗忘。

克莱布里克支架、格兰姆棱镜和洛林曲柄均为增幅器部件，可以在希图斯的夜羽洞穴内进行组装。

descriptions.en: Seize fractal power. This pack includes the Citrine Warframe, Steflos and Corufell weapons, Citrine Sigil, Alumeti Sugatra, Citrine Kalite Helmet, and the Belric and Rania Reunited Ship Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 掌控分形的力量。这个组合包内含 Citrine 战甲、石晶之花和闪劫武器、Citrine 纹章、矾茂坠饰、Citrine 盐烁头盔，以及贝里克与拉尼娅团聚飞船装饰。

descriptions.en: Take aim as the sharpshooter Warframe, Cyte-09, along with his signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh: 以神枪手战甲 Cyte-09 的身份瞄准目标，并配备其标志性武器和自定义装备。

descriptions.en: Gaze into the mirror that accuses. This collection includes the Dagath Warframe, her Dorrclave weapon, the Dagath Ganceann Helmet, and Aumen Kaithe Gear.
descriptions.zh: 凝视控诉之镜。该组合包内含 Dagath 战甲、她的怒斩武器、Dagath 无首头盔，以及金兆绝灵骥装备。

descriptions.en: Write a new chapter for the keeper of history. His collection includes the Dante Warframe, Dante Cantist Helmet, Rencowl Syandana, Oranist Armor, Ruvox Melee Weapon, and Noctua's Paragrimm Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 为历史的守护者谱写新的篇章。他的组合包内含 Dante 战甲、Dante 撰诗者头盔、富思披饰、奥哲护甲、古声近战武器以及夜枭的幽幽鹰装饰。

descriptions.en: Make art your weapon, with the shadowgrapher Follie
descriptions.zh: 通过绘影者 Follie 将艺术与你的武器完美融合

descriptions.en: The conductive path to Gyre’s core. This collection includes the Gyre Warframe, Gyre Automaton Helmet, Alternox Rifle, Triodic Syandana, and Gyratory Sphere Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通往 Gyre 核心的传导之路。该组合包内含 Gyre 战甲、Gyre 姬械头盔、电幻步枪、三重披饰，以及回旋球装饰。

descriptions.en: Life and death meet in Jade. Her collection includes the Jade Warframe, Jade Aureolt Helmet, Motetique Signa, Harmony scythe, Cantare throwing blades, Evensong bow, and Jade Ophanim Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 生与死在 Jade 身上交汇。她的组合包内含 Jade 战甲、Jade 圣环头盔、圣歌头环、和谐镰刀、歌颂投掷刀刃、晚祷弓箭，和 Jade 座天使装饰。

descriptions.en: Seize your destiny with the dice-maiden. Her collection includes the Koumei Warframe, her Orihime Helmet, Amanata, Higasa weapons, Buyoh and Rolling Fates Emotes, the Koumei Ito Glyph and Sigil, and the Koumei Engimono Decoration.
descriptions.zh: 通过掷骰巫女掌握自己的命运。她的组合包内含 Koumei 战甲、织姬头盔、天薙刀、晴日伞武器、日本舞和命运掷骰表情动作、Koumei 提线浮印和纹章，以及 Koumei 祈运坛装饰。
化身为冬日风暴之灵。Narin 锋利的细剑在呼啸的暴风雪之中舞动，剑气冲霄，即带来庇护，也带来毁灭。

descriptions.en: Grow strong with Nokko, brave defender of the Deepmines.
descriptions.zh: 与深矿的勇敢捍卫者 Nokko 一起成长。

descriptions.en: Stalk your prey through the floating islands of Duviri with the new Oraxia Bundle! Featuring the deadly hunter Oraxia, as well as her signature Weapons and Customizations.
descriptions.zh: 通过全新的 Oraxia 组合包，在双衍王境的漂浮岛屿上追踪你的猎物！内含致命猎手 Oraxia，以及她的标志性武器和自定义装饰。

descriptions.en: Command the wrath of Kullervo. His collection includes the Kullervo Warframe, Kullervo Usvah Helmet, Ahlto Syandana, and Rauta Shotgun.
descriptions.zh: 掌控 Kullervo 的愤怒。组合包内含 Kullervo 战甲、Kullervo 幽雾头盔、幽浪披饰以及锐铁霰弹枪。

descriptions.en: Summon a guardian with the strength to face Albrecht’s Laboratories. This collection includes the Qorvex Warframe, Qorvex Raxpart Helmet, Portcull Syandana, and Mandonel Archgun.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一位有实力面对阿尔布雷希特实验室的守护者。该组合包内含 Qorvex 战甲、Qorvex 壁垒头盔、吊闸披饰和辐光弩炮曲翼枪械。

descriptions.en: Adapt to overcome any threat with Caliban, the perfect fusion of Sentient and Warframe capabilities. This collection includes the Caliban Warframe, the Caliban Cranion Helmet, Venato scythe, Neurovyre Syandana and Sporavyre Sugatra.
descriptions.zh: Sentient 和战甲功能的完美融合，用 Caliban 适应并克服任何威胁。该组合包内含 Caliban 战甲、Caliban 锐颅头盔、脉纹镰刀、灵噬披饰和孢噬坠饰。

descriptions.en: Never let the music be silenced with Temple.
descriptions.zh: 永远不要让 Temple 的音乐沉寂。

descriptions.en: Call down brimstone-laced devastation and take command of demonic servitors with Uriel, the Heretic of Xata.
descriptions.zh: 与 Xata 的异端者 Uriel 一起，召唤硫磺带来的毁灭性灾难，并指挥恶魔的仆从。

descriptions.en: Revere the relentless hunting shadow. This pack includes the Voruna Warframe, Sarofang and Perigale weapons, Voruna's Anukas Helmet and Voidshell Skin with Rough Cryotic material structure, the Okuri Tails Ephemera, and the Lua's Pack Mural.
descriptions.zh: 敬畏无情的暗影猎手。该组合包内含：Voruna 战甲、沙罗之牙和月面狂风武器、Voruna 冥魂头盔和带有永冻晶矿糙纹材质结构的虚空之壳外观、狼妖尾幻纹，以及月之狼群壁画。

descriptions.en: Put the fear of the Void into your foes with Sevagoth, the reaper of souls. Collection includes Sevagoth, Sevagoth Lucifuge helmet, Epitaph sidearm, Vithil Syandana and 3 day Affinity and Credit boosters.
descriptions.zh: 化身为灵魂收割者 Sevagoth 来把你的敌人带入虚空的恐惧中。该组合包内含 Sevagoth 战甲、Sevagoth 避光头盔、葬铭次要武器、威丝披饰和三天经验值与现金加成。

descriptions.en: The greatest journey begins with a single step. Prepare your arsenal for Wukong Qitian with this bundle containing the original forms of the Wukong Warframe and Sun & Moon dual blades.
descriptions.zh: 千里之行始于足下。通过这款包含 Wukong 战甲原始版本以及赤阳 & 幽月双刀的组合包为迎接齐天大圣做好准备。

descriptions.en: The youthful sovereign of the sea arises from the waves, attired for battle. Includes Yareli Warframe, Yareli Physalia Helmet, Kompressa Pistol, Merulina Syandana and 3-day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
descriptions.zh: 风华正茂的深海主宰自海浪中升起，披挂上阵。该组合包内含 Yareli 战甲、Yareli 蜇逸头盔、卡帕压力枪（手枪）、浪漪珊瑚披饰，以及 3 天经验值与现金加成。

descriptions.en: Why choose just one?
descriptions.zh: 为什么只要一个？

descriptions.en: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the Grineer participants of Tactical Alert: Dog Days.
descriptions.zh: 一系列描绘战术警报：三伏天中 Grineer 参与者的摇头娃娃。

names.zh: 三伏天摇头娃娃组合包

descriptions.en:
A collection of weapon skins made by fellow Tenno, from the Warframe community.

Designs by: MaaYuu, Verifitas, ming1345, ZeroJackdaw, Rekkou, and StratoS117
descriptions.zh:
一组收藏了来自 Warframe 社区，由以下 Tenno 所设计的武器外观组合包。
 
Tenno 出品的设计者们：MaaYuu，Verifitas，ming1345，ZeroJackdaw，Rekkou，StratoS117

descriptions.en: A festive collection of Solstice skins for the Titania Warframe, Heliocor, Daedalus Armor, Salix Syandana, a Kavat Gene-Masking Kit and a Kubrow Gene-Masking Kit. Includes a 3-day Affinity and Credit booster.
descriptions.zh: 一套由 Titania 战甲、赫利俄光锤、代达罗斯护甲、柳树披饰、库娃基因组合包、库狛基因组合包等冬至外观所组成的节庆组合包。内含有 3 天经验与现金加成。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的浮印收藏。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的浮印收藏。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的浮印收藏。

descriptions.en: This essential bundle contains everything you need to bring the Winter spirit to Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 这个重要的同捆包中拥有每一项你所需要能为战甲带来冬幕精神的道具。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the Winter holidays in style! This bundle includes Mirage and a host of Winter-themed items.
descriptions.zh: 好好打扮来庆祝冬幕假期吧！这个组合包内含Mirage 以​​及许多以冬幕为主题的道具。

descriptions.en: A collection of festive glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 节日用浮印的组合包。

descriptions.en: A collection of winter themed glyphs.
descriptions.zh: 一组冬季主题的浮印收藏。

descriptions.en: Arca Armor that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 带有节日气息的弧电护甲。

descriptions.en: Creation and destruction intermingle in this ethereal bundle for Wisp. Contains Wisp, her signature Fulmin lightning rifle, Sirocco Kavat Armor, the alternate Gaoth Helmet as well as 3-day credit and affinity boosters.
descriptions.zh: 创造和毁灭在这飘渺的组合包中交织在一起。此组合包内含 Wisp、她的独特雷霆闪电步枪、西洛可库娃护甲、轻风替换头盔，以及 3 天现金和经验值加成。

descriptions.en: A bundle featuring a Man in the Wall and Albrecht Entrati Glyph from Community Artists SirEnarion & death_ma666ots
descriptions.zh: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 SirEnarion 和 death_ma666ots 设计的墙中人和阿尔布雷希特·英择谛浮印。

names.en: Whispers in the Walls Community Glyph Bundle

descriptions.en: The signature battle armor of the only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
descriptions.zh: 能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的唯一可怕狂人的标志性战斗护甲。

descriptions.en: A pair of glyphs depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six.
descriptions.zh: 描绘着土星六号之狼的一对浮印

names.en: Wolf of Saturn Six Glyph Bundle
names.zh: 土星六号之狼浮印组合包

descriptions.en: The Yuvan Clerisy commissioned these golden statues to honor Lua's guardian pack. They are now yours to cherish. The collection includes the Steadfast Dynar Bust, Steadfast Raksh Bust, Steadfast Lycath Bust, and Steadfast Ulfrun Bust.
descriptions.zh: 青春仪使团委托制作了这些金色雕像来纪念守护月球的狼群。它们现在交给你来珍藏。该组合包内含坚韧的戴拿半身铜像、坚韧的亚克什半身铜像、坚韧的莱卡斯半身铜像和坚韧的乌尔佛伦半身铜像。

descriptions.en: A collection of Immortal Wukong items, including Wukong Samadhi Skin, Meteor Whip Skin, and the Subhuti Syandana.
descriptions.zh: Wukong 不朽物品组合包，包含 Wukong 三摩提外观 、流星鞭外观，以及须菩提披饰。

descriptions.en:
Adorn Wukong in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Wukong Voidshell Skin and Rubedo Impression material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Wukong 虚空之壳外观以及红色印象材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

descriptions.en: Decorate your Orbiter with a complete set of Gallixware ceramics. Each piece was handcrafted by the esteemed Orokin artist, Bren Terrasiam. The bundle includes three vases, a plate, a bowl, and an amphora.
descriptions.zh: 用一整套高力士陶瓷装饰你的轨道飞行器。每件作品均由受人尊敬的奥罗金艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆手工制作而成。该组合包内含三个花瓶、一个盘子、一个碗和一个双耳瓶。

descriptions.en: Deck the Necralisk with these festive Tennobaum Glyphs!
descriptions.zh: 通过这些节庆 Tennobaum 浮印来装扮殁世幽都！

names.zh: 英择谛 Tennobaum 浮印组合包

descriptions.en: Pathfinders will use this collection well. Express the Zariman spirit of innovation with the Parallax Landing Craft and its four unique skins.
descriptions.zh: 探路者将会利用好这个组合包。通过星察登陆艇及其四种独特外观来表达扎里曼的创新精神。

descriptions.en:
Don morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes fifteen material structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 15 款材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

names.zh: 霍姆巴斯的虚空之壳组合包

descriptions.en:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Saryn Voidshell Skin, Volt Voidshell Skin, Rhino Voidshell Skin, each skin’s matching material structure, and fifteen additional materials structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
descriptions.zh:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Saryn 虚空之壳外观、Volt 虚空之壳外观、Rhino 虚空之壳外观；以及每个外观的配套材质结构和十五种额外的材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。
